pages.text: Extends the network to another part of your workshop. Each linked Relay discovers nearby inventories and workstations within five blocks.$(br2)It has no internal inventory.

Relays automatically connect to nearby same-channel Relays, Nexuses, and Storage Crystals. Ordinary range is 16 blocks.$(br2)Apply $(item)Range Attunements$() to both Relays for longer automatic links. Apply a $(item)Dimensional Attunement$() to each upgraded Relay, then pair them with the wand for dimensional links. Each successful upgrade consumes one attunement in survival.
pages.title: Relay upgrades

pages.text: Ordinary links reach 16 blocks; two range-upgraded Relays reach 4,096. Rune endpoint reach defaults to 64.$(br2)Each leg needs clear sight through loaded chunks. Glass and other transparent blocks pass; opaque shapes block it.$(br2)Relays take the shortest visible route around obstructions. These ranges are configurable.
pages.title: Range and sight
